https://www.hankookilbo.com/news/article.summary: Servers of MetaM, the contractor that handles Coinone's customer support, were attacked from outside, and personal data that customers left during support conversations was leaked (according to Coinone's notice).

https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10937.summary: An unauthorized outsider accessed the mobile local gift certificate platform "Chak" and viewed some of the personal data of 3,083 users (according to KOMSCO's announcement).

https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10937.title: 30 Korean servers on the target list of an attacker suspected to be Lazarus
https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10937.summary: Threat intelligence firm CYFIRMA said 30 servers in Korea were on the target list of an attacker suspected to be linked to the North Korean hacking group Lazarus. Whether any were actually breached has not been confirmed.

https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10937.title: Inje University: over 24,000 records of student, faculty and staff data leaked in external attack
https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10937.summary: A server related to the university's course management site was attacked from outside, and 24,011 records containing the student ID numbers, names, email addresses and mobile phone numbers of students, faculty and staff were leaked (according to the university's announcement).

https://www.etnews.com/20261113000152.title: Work messenger Kakao Work: emails, messages and more leaked through outside access
https://www.etnews.com/20261113000152.summary: An outside attacker gained unauthorized access to the system of the work messenger Kakao Work, and user information, email bodies and attachments, and encrypted messages were leaked. The extent of the damage is under investigation.

https://www.naewoeilbo.com/news/articleV.title: Suspected unauthorized viewing of personal data on the Korea Federation of SMEs' Yellow Umbrella website
https://www.naewoeilbo.com/news/articleV.summary: An unauthorized outsider gained abnormal access to the Yellow Umbrella website, and it has been confirmed that some members' personal data may have been viewed. The actual scale of the leak is under investigation.

https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10936.summary: An AI solution supplier to the Ministry of SMEs and Startups' "Startup for All" program was hacked, and the names, phone numbers and email addresses of 20,028 users were leaked. https://www.fnnews.com/news/202611130929.title: KB Capital: data of 1,811 people, including customers and partner employees, leaked in external attack
https://www.fnnews.com/news/202611130929.summary: A car rental asset management system used by employees and partners was attacked from outside, and the personal data of 1,811 customers, partner employees, executives and employees was leaked (according to the company's preliminary count).

https://view.asiae.co.kr/article/2026111.title: MUJI: about 1.09 million card numbers may have been exposed through unauthorized system access
https://view.asiae.co.kr/article/2026111.summary: Systems of Ryohin Keikaku, the company that runs MUJI, were accessed without authorization, and it has been confirmed that about 1.09 million MUJI Card numbers that should have been deleted may have been exposed (according to announcements by the company and the card company).

https://m.sedaily.com/article/20113739.title: Flybit: personal data of 40 customers leaked through unauthorized groupware access
https://m.sedaily.com/article/20113739.summary: An outside attacker accessed the internal groupware of virtual asset exchange Flybit, and the personal data of 40 customers contained in email attachments was leaked (according to the company's announcement).

https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBM.title: Maersk investigates legacy-system breach after WhiteArmor ransomware group claims 100GB logistics data theft

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AhpzB_gE.title: Victorian education authority website hacked during Year 12 final exams

https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10934.title: Japan's Yasukuni Shrine online store: about 14,500 member records leaked
https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10934.summary: An online sales site run by Yasukuni Shrine in Tokyo, Japan, was accessed without authorization, and about 14,500 member records were leaked (according to the shrine's announcement).

https://www.ddaily.co.kr/page/view/20261.title: Financial Security Institute: administrative forms and personal data leaked in external intrusion
https://www.ddaily.co.kr/page/view/20261.summary: The institute said an external intrusion into its system for evaluating financial companies leaked about 200 administrative forms and over 650 records of personal and user information, and that sensitive data such as resident registration numbers was not leaked.

https://bleepingcomputer.com/news/securi.title: Vanderbilt University in the US orders campus devices shut down after cyberattack
https://bleepingcomputer.com/news/securi.summary: To respond to the breach, the university asked its members to shut down their devices and disconnect from campus Wi-Fi. A ransomware group claimed to have stolen more than 1 million records, but the university has not confirmed this.

https://www.fnnews.com/news/202611070825.title: Mirae Asset Securities: customer and employee data leaked in external attack
https://www.fnnews.com/news/202611070825.summary: Its mobile web login service and groupware were attacked, leaking the account numbers of about 3,800 customers and the data of about 35,000 executives and employees. The company said no financial losses have been confirmed.

https://www.hankyung.com/article/2026102.title: Ring arrested for using AI to hack over 90 organizations and steal 8.2 million personal data records
https://www.hankyung.com/article/2026102.summary: Police arrested a ring that used AI coding agents and autonomous penetration tools to steal about 8.2 million personal data records from over 90 organizations, including hospitals, universities and private academies, and demanded money.
https://www.hankyung.com/article/2026102.org: Over 90 companies and institutions in Korea

https://www.mt.co.kr/article/20261023213.title: Korean Air and Asiana: data leaked through reservation system operator
https://www.mt.co.kr/article/20261023213.summary: Unauthorized access to an account at the overseas operator of a reservation and ticketing system that both airlines use leaked customer booking information. Payment information was not included, and the extent of the damage is under investigation.

https://bleepingcomputer.com/news/securi.title: Capcom confirms leak of about 11.77 million CAPCOM ID records
https://bleepingcomputer.com/news/securi.summary: The company said a cyberattack exposed the email addresses, login histories and IP addresses in about 11.77 million CAPCOM ID records worldwide, and that the passwords of some accounts were changed without authorization.

https://biz.sbs.co.kr/amp/article/200003.title: Hollys: about 2.76 million past membership records leaked
https://biz.sbs.co.kr/amp/article/200003.summary: While an outside attacker was accessing its cloud without authorization, user IDs, passwords, addresses and other data in about 2.76 million membership records from 2009 to 2020 (including duplicates) were leaked.

https://bleepingcomputer.com/news/securi.title: Burger King Japan: about 11.18 million app member records leaked
https://bleepingcomputer.com/news/securi.summary: Unauthorized access to a server of the official app's membership system leaked about 11.18 million records containing names, email addresses, phone numbers, dates of birth and other data.

https://aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/13/un.title: Hundreds of French supermarkets throw away food after refrigeration systems hacked
https://aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/13/un.summary: Refrigeration controllers exposed to the internet were attacked, raising the temperature of refrigerators and freezers at hundreds of supermarkets, which threw away large amounts of food. Paris prosecutors have opened an investigation.

https://www.koreajoongangdaily.com/korea.title: Servers of two Seoul megachurches breached, signs of member data leak
https://www.koreajoongangdaily.com/korea.summary: Signs emerged that the two churches' servers were breached. Yoido Full Gospel Church said the data of about 850,000 of its members may have been leaked, and a security firm said the data of about 89,000 SaRang Community Church members may have been leaked.
https://www.koreajoongangdaily.com/korea.org: Yoido Full Gospel Church, SaRang Community Church

https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/se.title: Ransomware hits Japan's IDCF Cloud, services down for 495 organizations
https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/se.summary: A cloud region of IDC Frontier, a SoftBank group company, was hit by a ransomware attack that stopped the servers of about 495 companies and local governments, and backup recovery was also disrupted.

https://biz.sbs.co.kr/amp/article/200003.title: E-learning contractor hacked, user data of over 20 institutions leaked
https://biz.sbs.co.kr/amp/article/200003.summary: Servers of a company that ran training sites on behalf of several institutions were breached, and about 2.37 million user records from over 20 client institutions were leaked (according to the company's report).

https://biz.sbs.co.kr/amp/article/200003.title: KEPCO: data of over 24,000 employees exposed on an external web page
https://biz.sbs.co.kr/amp/article/200003.summary: It was confirmed that the names, departments, contact details and other data of about 24,000 employees had been posted on an external web page. The company said customer data was not included.

https://biz.sbs.co.kr/amp/article/200003.title: Shinhan Bank: data of about 25,000 customers leaked in hack
https://biz.sbs.co.kr/amp/article/200003.summary: The identity verification step of a lookup service for loan brokers was bypassed, leaking the names, contact details, income and other data of about 25,000 customers.

https://www.nippon.com/en/news/yjj202610.title: Japan's Sagawa Express: fears of mass data leak after unauthorized access to delivery tracking
https://www.nippon.com/en/news/yjj202610.summary: A third party gained unauthorized access to the delivery tracking service. The company said up to about 53.23 million records (including duplicates) with names, addresses, phone numbers and other data may have been leaked.

https://bleepingcomputer.com/news/securi.title: Image sharing service Gyazo: over 20 million user records leaked
https://bleepingcomputer.com/news/securi.summary: A vulnerability in an upload server was exploited, leaking about 23.62 million user records containing email addresses, password hashes and other data.

https://biz.sbs.co.kr/amp/article/200003.title: Weverse confirms leak of payment-related data from over 420,000 accounts
https://biz.sbs.co.kr/amp/article/200003.summary: It was confirmed that internal identifiers and purchase and refund histories for about 422,000 accounts leaked out of the fan platform Weverse.

https://bleepingcomputer.com/news/securi.title: ID verification company IDScan confirms mass leak of driver's license data
https://bleepingcomputer.com/news/securi.summary: US ID verification company IDScan.net confirmed a breach, and more than 153 million scans of US and Canadian driver's licenses advertised for sale on the dark web (as claimed by the seller) have reportedly been linked to the incident.

https://www.hankyung.com/article/2026111.title: RIKEN's Fugaku supercomputer hacked; information of up to 4,597 users may have leaked
https://www.hankyung.com/article/2026111.summary: An outsider broke into the operations system of RIKEN's supercomputer Fugaku and tampered with servers, and information on up to 4,597 users, some credentials and research data were taken or may have been taken (according to RIKEN).

https://www.cbci.co.kr/news/articleView..title: Optimizely hack plants malicious script on websites of 178 organizations, including CNN and the BBC
https://www.cbci.co.kr/news/articleView..summary: An attacker exploited a flaw in website experimentation platform Optimizely to add malicious JavaScript to customer projects. The code was found on the websites of 178 organizations, including CNN and the BBC (according to security firm Report URI's analysis).

https://www.khan.co.kr/article/202611161.title: Government work email hacked, abnormal access on about 300 accounts
https://www.khan.co.kr/article/202611161.summary: An outside attacker got into the government's work email system through some local government networks and a flaw in single sign-on (SSO), and abnormal access was found on about 300 accounts (according to the Ministry of the Interior and Safety).
https://www.khan.co.kr/article/202611161.org: Ministry of the Interior and Safety (MOIS)

https://www.kwnews.co.kr/article/2026111.title: Kangwon National University: research management system hacked, user data leaked
https://www.kwnews.co.kr/article/2026111.summary: An unauthorized outsider accessed the server of the integrated research management system of Kangwon National University's Industry-Academic Cooperation Foundation and took user information. Victims whose data included a birth date number 27, and the total number of people affected has not been disclosed (according to the university's notice).

https://www.segye.com/newsView/202611175.title: Mega MGC Coffee: customer center contractor hacked, leaking phone numbers of 30 customers
https://www.segye.com/newsView/202611175.summary: An outside attacker went through the servers of MetaM, the contractor that runs Mega MGC Coffee's customer center, into the customer center system, and the mobile phone numbers of 30 customers were leaked (according to the company).

https://www.boannews.com/news/articleVie.title: City of Osaka: about 1.08 million email addresses leaked through a hacked outside email service
https://www.boannews.com/news/articleVie.summary: An outside email delivery service, Arara Message, used by the City of Osaka's Administrative Online System was accessed without authorization, and 1,078,713 user email addresses were leaked (according to the City of Osaka).
